title: Page Six's inaugural 'Virtual Reali-Tea' Awards honors A-list reality stars during unforgettable night - NewsBreak
text:
By Bernie Zilio ,
6 hours ago
It was a starry night of A-list reality stars at Page Six’s inaugural “Virtual Reali-Tea” Awards live event. James Keivom It was a starry night of A-list reality stars at Page Six’s inaugural “Virtual Reali-Tea” Awards live event.
Hosted by Danny Murphy and Evan Real of “VRT” podcast fame, the dazzling soirée, which was sponsored by Tri-State Cadillac and Malibu, kicked off Wednesday evening with an unforgettable pink carpet at City Winery NYC.
“Real Housewives” from Miami, Orange County, New Jersey, Atlanta and Potomac, as well as notable faces from “Vanderpump Rules,” “Southern Hospitality,” “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives” and more, dressed to impress as they posed for photos and stopped for interviews.

Per usual, the tea they spilled was piping hot.
After the carpet concluded, Murphy and Real took the stage to bring the audience on a journey of laughs, nostalgia and (of course) a little drama as they chatted with reality television favorites.
“RHOM” stars Alexia Nepola and Marysol Patton were on hand to collect their Golden Kettle Award, presented by Tri-State Cadillac, and “RHONJ” star Melissa Gorga was there to be named “Mother” while her husband, Joe Gorga, was recognized as “The Most Valuable Plus-One.”

The “RHOP” alum lit up the stage. James Keivom “RHOM” stars Alexia Nepola, Julia Lemigova and Marysol Patton took the stage to accept awards. James Keivom “RHOA” alum Phaedra Parks, “Pump Rules” alum Scheana Shay and “SLOMW” star Jessi Ngatikaura also took the stage to chat with Murphy and Real in front of hundreds of adoring fans.
But what’s an award show without music? “RHOP” alum Candiace Dillard Bassett, who received the Magic Mic Award , appropriately put on a jaw-dropping performance of her biggest hits during the event.
Other winners included “Real Housewives of Beverly Hills” star Dorit Kemsley (Most Coveted Closet), “The Hills” star Kristin Cavallari (Comeback Queen), “Love Island USA” star Amaya Espinal (A Reali-Tea Star is Born) and “Here Comes Honey Boo Boo” star Alana Thompson (Best Clip, Clip Clip!).

James Keivom Bravo honcho Andy Cohen, who was named Hot-Tea of the Year, sent in a special video straight from the “Watch What Happens Live” Clubhouse to celebrate his victory.
“This is the first time I’ve ever gotten anything from Page Six besides a headache — just kidding!” he quipped in the clip.
The celebs kept the excitement going with a VIP afterparty at David Rodolitz’s Flyfish Club, where “Summer House” star-turned-DJ Kyle Cooke brought the house down with a killer set.
Guests danced into the wee hours of the night as they sipped on Malibu specialty cocktails and Loverboy.
